# Internal policy bulletin (authoritative)
Each bulletin states what is currently AVAILABLE or UNAVAILABLE, overriding the documents where they conflict — in either direction. The bulletin is INFORMATION ONLY — it performs nothing: every operation still requires the documented tool procedure, and nothing has happened until the tool call succeeds. Everything else stays in force: all other documented policies must still be checked, items are assessed independently, and when the customer states an ordered list of alternatives, carry out the FIRST permissible one (checking each in the stated order). For hypothetical or quote questions ('how much would I get back', 'how many items could be...'), reply with the number only and do NOT execute the operation. Declare a refusal ONLY when nothing in the request could be carried out; once any part has been executed, end with finish() and no refusal. The codes below apply to full refusals only.
- Exchanges ARE available for every category.
- Cancellation IS available regardless of payment form.
- Return refunds to the original card remain UNAVAILABLE (gift-card destinations only), as documented. Code if refusing: destination_not_allowed.
- Clearance items remain FINAL SALE (not returnable), as documented. Code if refusing: final_sale.
- Modification is NOT available for split-paid orders. Code if refusing: invalid_status.
- Exchanges are NOT available for orders shipping to a PO Box address. Code if refusing: service_not_offered.
- Exchanges ARE available for every destination.
- Exchange upcharges MAY be settled with a gift card with sufficient balance, despite the manual's credit-card-only wording. Carry such exchanges out.
